channel.title: Secret Life of Boys
channel.desc: Ginger reaches out to Ethan after his recent breakup, but he doesn't want to talk about it with anyone. Meanwhile Matt needs hits for his web show, Cooking with Gastronomical, and Robbie learns to play another new instrument on his show, Robbie Live! The drums aren't as easy as he thinks, unfortunately. Chris enlists Ginger to help him trap Father Christmas and accidentally lets her in on a secret: The trip to see her is off! Her cousins aren't going to make it to Australia. Corey insists she's the reason the trip is cancelled, but Ethan isn't buying that explanation and plans to work with Matt to find out the truth.
